■ Stage Direction
Age: Mid-30s
Personality: Suspicious

★ Request
Haru Urara runs out of frame

★ Request
Costume: Casual Clothes
Together?

Her efforts might be pointing in the completely wrong direction, but Haru Urara is earnest.
As her Trainer, her dedication touches my heart.
Hey there, little lady. Looking for something?

Ugh. Of course I'll practice a whole lot too!
But I wanted to get fast right away!

These are the exact "shoes that make you super fast"!
I'll even give you a discount right now, how about it?

People praised me for running with lots and lots of energy,
so if I take 1st place, they'll praise me even more, right!

Well, you see~... Wait, Trainer?!
What are you doing here?

I'd be super happy if I won 1st place!
And Trainer would get praised too, so that'd make me even happier!

Really, really, for real?!
Hmmm, they're expensive, but... all right!

On a day off, as I headed out near the station,
I heard a familiar voice.

High-spirited, Haru Urara takes off running toward Tracen Academy.
Seeing her determination renewed my own resolve to help her take 1st place.

So I wanted to try hard and take 1st place as fast as possible
to surprise you!

Really?! Ehehe♪ I got praised!
Then next week, I'll definitely get those speed shoes...

Well, isn't that perfect!
I've got the exact right pair of shoes for an Umamusume like you. Look here.
Of course! With these, taking 1st place is a guaranteed lock!

All right! Starting tomorrow, Trainer and I
are gonna train a whole bunch together!

Okay, off I go right away!
See ya later!

A street vendor calls out to Haru Urara,
who seems to be searching for something...

Yep! Me too!
But what I'm buying is part of a top-secret master plan, so it's a secret!

Huh? I don't need ordinary shoes~!
What I'm looking for are shoes that make me super fast!

Haru Urara dashes off in an instant.
Curious about what she was up to, I followed after her.
Huh? Trainer!

My secret master plan was a total bust~!
And here I thought I'd instantly become fast today!

Remember how that reporter praised you the other day, Trainer?
It just made me feel so, so happy!

Uuugh... I can just barely afford them...!
Will they really, truly make me faster?

...I see. Yeah, you're right!
I should've just asked you from the start, Trainer!

Yeah! I'm looking for a shoe store!
Do you know one, mister?
Urara's secret master plan... commences nowww!
Like shoes that make you run fast or something like that!
Ummm, if I remember right, the magazine said it was around here...

Whaaat?! Those shoes that make you fast were fake?!
Even though he said "1st place is a guaranteed lock"~!
